cp34:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi Ekarājā ti vissuto paramaṃ sīlaṃ adhiṭṭhāya pasāsāmi mahāmahiṃ. || ||
cp34:2.1: Dasakusalakammapathe vattāmi anavasesato catūhi saṅgahavatthūhi saṅgaṇhāmi mahājanaṃ. || ||
cp34:3.1: Evaṃ me appamattassa idha loke parattha ca Dabbaseno upāgantvā acchindanto puraṃ mama, || ||
cp34:4.1: rāj' ūpajīve nigame sabalaṭṭhe saraṭṭhake sabbaṃ hatthagataṃ katvā kāsuyā nikhaṇī mamaṃ. || ||
cp34:5.1: Amaccamaṇḍalaṃ rajjaṃ phītaṃ antepuraṃ mama acchinditvāna gahitaṃ piyaṃ puttaṃ va pass' ahaṃ; mettāya me samo natthi esā me mettāpāramīti. || ||
